---
name: dependabot-prs-always-fail-the-pin-check
description: "Every dependabot PR here fails Lint & Test on the workspace pins; fix them as one combined branch, and restore the pins before resolving"
metadata:
  type: project
---

Dependabot resolves the root package with SwiftPM alone, so every one of its PRs
writes a 20-pin `Package.resolved` and drops the five Xcode-workspace pins. The
`mise run lint` check reads `HEAD` and fails all of them, while the four heavy
jobs pass — the code is never the problem. Measured on #133/#134/#135
(2026-09-07).

**Why:** fixing them one at a time costs a 13-minute CI run each and the second
PR then conflicts with the first on the same file. One branch carrying every
bump is one run and one merge; dependabot closes its own PRs once the versions
land on main.

**How to apply:** bump the requirement in `Package.swift`, run
`swift package update <names>` for the bumped packages only (a bare
`swift package update` moves the whole graph), then restore the five missing
pin blocks from `git show HEAD:Package.resolved` and run
`xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace
-scheme ReachyMini -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData` to confirm the merge — it
leaves the file byte-identical when the set is valid.

**Do not** restore the pins by resolving the workspace from scratch: with the
five entries absent, the resolver picks `swift-custom-dump` 1.7.0 plus
`xctest-dynamic-overlay` instead of 1.7.3 plus `swift-issue-reporting` (the same
upstream repository under two identities), which is an unrelated downgrade in a
dependency-bump diff. Order decides the answer.

Local `mise run build` cannot verify any of this — it selects the swift.org
toolchain and fails on `LongRunningIntent`. Use `xcrun swift build`, which is
Xcode's Swift and the configuration CI uses. Related:
[[package-resolved-originhash-churn]], [[main-is-unprotected-auto-merge-does-not-wait]],
[[stale-build-cache-fakes-a-compile-failure]] — the bump's second failure, and the one
that is not about pins at all.

version: 2

# Tools pinned in mise.toml are NOT covered here — Dependabot has no mise
# ecosystem. They stay a manual bump (see AGENTS.md), and `mise outdated` will
# not surface them either, because exact pins always match their own request.
# Use `./bin/mise latest <tool>`.
updates:
  - package-ecosystem: github-actions
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
    commit-message:
      # cliff.toml skips `chore(deps)`, keeping bumps out of the changelog.
      prefix: chore(deps)
    groups:
      actions:
        patterns: ["*"]

  - package-ecosystem: swift
    directory: "/"
    schedule:
      interval: weekly
      day: monday
    commit-message:
      prefix: chore(deps)
    groups:
      swift-openapi:
        patterns: ["swift-openapi-*"]
